before: The marks of a hanging full-width mark covered its whole advance, and a line whose hanging mark moved to the next line kept its hang.
after: With punctuation compression, the marks of a hanging full-width mark end before its trailing blank, and a line whose hanging mark moves to the next line ends at its margin.
reason: The change affects paint and the alignment of the line a carried mark leaves. Line breaks, characters, and collaborative state stay the same.
